methodologyNotes: Roster covers eleven verified models from the brief; the MZ Skin Light-Therapy Golden Mask is omitted (the brief named a 'Golden Mask'; MZ Skin's current US-stocked LED model is the distinct LightMAX Supercharged 2.0 at $950, so no Golden-Mask USD MSRP could be confirmed and no substitute was fabricated). Specs were independently re-verified 2026-06-20 against manufacturer product pages (Omnilux, CurrentBody, Dr. Dennis Gross, Therabody, SharkNinja, Qure, HigherDOSE, Skin Gym, Aphrona) plus major US retailers (Dermstore, Amazon, Best Buy) and the FDA 510(k) database. fda_cleared is true only when the manufacturer page or FDA 510(k) record explicitly states clearance; it is null where clearance could not be corroborated. wavelengths_nm reflects brand-declared values; where the brand declares a value that differs from third-party reviews, the brand value is used. led_count is total diodes as stated by the brand. treatment_time_min is the recommended single-session duration. Prices are USD MSRP from the primary brand/retailer source. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Omnilux Contour FACE
products.provenance: Price ($395), 132 medical-grade LEDs (66 dual bulbs), wavelengths (633 nm red + 830 nm NIR), 10-minute treatment, FDA cleared, rechargeable controller, flexible medical-grade silicone, single simultaneous mode all confirmed via the official Omnilux product page and search corroboration. Launch year 2020 from trademark first-use-in-commerce; unchanged on re-verification.

products.name: CurrentBody Skin LED Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 2
products.provenance: Re-verified directly on the CurrentBody US page: $469.99, 236 LEDs (110 red 633 nm + 110 NIR 830 nm + 16 deep NIR 1072 nm), 10-minute session, USB-C rechargeable, flexible silicone. FDA 510(k) K250966 (Shenzhen Kaiyan, model MK-90H) dated June 25 2025 confirmed via FDA accessdata. Released September 2024 per CurrentBody and review sources. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: Dr. Dennis Gross DRx SpectraLite FaceWare Pro
products.provenance: Price ($455), 162 LEDs and five wavelengths (Blue 415 / Amber 605 / Red 630 / Deep Red 660 / Infrared 880 nm) confirmed verbatim on the Dermstore listing; the DDG brand page summarizes as 160 LEDs / 415 nm blue but the Dermstore spec sheet corroborates the full 162/five-wavelength figure. 3-minute auto-shutoff treatment, FDA cleared, USB rechargeable, rigid (non-silicone) shell, three modes confirmed. Release year not located in any verified source -> null.

products.name: Therabody TheraFace Mask Glo
products.provenance: Re-verified on the official Therabody page: $379.99, 504 medical-grade LEDs, wavelengths (Blue 415 / Red 633 / Infrared 830 nm), 12-minute pre-programmed routine, FDA cleared, USB-C rechargeable, protective eye shield included, three modes. Released October 2025 per Therabody and WWD. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: Shark CryoGlow LED Face Mask
products.provenance: Price ($349.99 base, mask-only FW312; bundles with charging stand list higher) and 160 tri-wick LEDs (480 total light sources) confirmed on the SharkNinja page. CORRECTED wavelengths: SharkNinja officially declares Red 630 nm, Blue 630 nm, Infrared 830 nm; the draft's 415 nm blue was an editorial override of the brand spec and was removed in favor of the brand-declared values (distinct values: 630 nm and 830 nm). FDA cleared, USB-C rechargeable, four modes (Better Aging 6 min / Skin Clearing 8 min / Skin Sustain 4 min / Under-Eye Revive 5-15 min). Rigid mask with clip-on chill pads (no flexible silicone). Launched Feb 2025 (CES 2025). treatment_time_min reflects Better Aging (6 min).

products.name: Qure Q-Rejuvalight Pro
products.provenance: Price ($399) re-verified on the official Qure page, 160 dual-core LEDs, five wavelengths (Blue 415 / Amber 605 / Red 630 / Deep Red 660 / Infrared 880 nm), 3-minute daily treatment, FDA cleared (K230042), USB-C rechargeable, protective eyewear included, three modes (Skin Rejuvenating / Skin Clearing / app-customizable zones). CORRECTED flexible_silicone false->true: Qure declares a flexible medical-grade silicone design and the brand plus multiple reviews confirm flexible silicone (the draft's 'false' was wrong). Named in TIME's Best Inventions 2024.

products.name: HigherDOSE Red Light Face Mask
products.provenance: Price ($349), 66 dual-core LEDs (132 diodes), wavelengths (630 nm red + 830 nm NIR, ~50 mW/cm2 total irradiance), 10- and 20-minute session modes, FDA cleared, lithium-ion rechargeable via USB-C, medical-grade flexible silicone confirmed on the official HigherDOSE page and Dermstore. light_modes=2 (the two timed programs). Released fall 2024. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: Skin Gym LED Pro Light Therapy Mask
products.provenance: Re-verified on the official Skin Gym page: $299.99, 198 LEDs (66 tri-core chips: Blue 465 / Red 630 / NIR 830 nm), 10-minute session, FDA cleared for full-face wrinkles and mild-to-moderate acne vulgaris, USB-C rechargeable, flexible medical-grade silicone, three modes. Release year not located -> null. All draft values confirmed. (Brief's 'Wrinklebye'/'WrinkLit' is a separate lower-tier model; LED Pro is the FDA-cleared product.)

products.name: Therabody TheraFace Mask (Advanced)
products.priceNote: Original MSRP; available as certified refurbished on therabody.com
products.provenance: 648 LEDs, wavelengths (Blue 415 / Red 633 / Infrared 830 nm), $649.99 MSRP, 9-minute preset (three 3-minute cycles), FDA cleared (Class II), rechargeable, removable protective eye shields, VibraWave vibration. Launched September 13 2023, confirmed via the official Therabody press release and Best Buy 'Advanced' listing. Currently sold as certified refurbished. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: Aphrona Moonlight Pro LED Facial Mask (7-Color)
products.provenance: Price ($145.99), 7 color modes (Red 630 / Blue 415 / Green 520 / Purple 390 / Cyan 490 nm, plus yellow and white without stated nm), 15-minute session, FDA 510(k) cleared Class II confirmed on the Aphrona page and Amazon. led_count 450 corroborated by the Amazon listing title ('450 Powerful LED Chips') and search; NOTE the current brand product page rendered '150 narrow-spectrum chips,' a discrepancy, but the better-corroborated 450 (two sources) is retained. Rechargeable status not stated -> null.

products.name: Aphrona Halo LED Face & Neck Mask
products.provenance: Price ($195.99), 807 LED chips (269 red + 269 orange + 269 blue), single 25-minute light cycle, patented protective eye cover, silicone frame confirmed on the official Aphrona page. Wavelengths (Blue 415 / Orange 605 / Red 630 / NIR 850 nm) sourced from the Amazon listing/third-party (brand page omits nm) -> treat as approximate. CORRECTED fda_cleared true->null: neither the Aphrona Halo product page nor search corroborates FDA clearance for the Halo specifically (clearance is confirmed only for the Moonlight Pro), so this is nulled rather than asserted. Rechargeable status not stated -> null. light_modes=1 (all three colors run in one combined cycle).
